releaseNotes:
The first release of **Nova Echo**, a desktop agent that chats with you, listens to your voice, and can operate your computer with your permission, powered by Compass.

## ✨ What's New

### 🖥️ A Desktop Agent That Can Use Your Computer

- Nova Echo can see your screen and use the mouse and keyboard to carry out tasks for you.
- Multi-monitor setups, window focus, and drag actions.
- Nova can read on-screen controls through accessibility information, so it can click and type more precisely.
- Nova can open allowlisted apps, manage windows, work with files and the clipboard, and run commands, all limited to folders you allow.

### 💬 Chat Powered by Compass

- A single chat window with formatted (Markdown) replies, plus **Stop** and **Clear** controls.
- Replies stream in as they are generated.
- Compass tools are available directly in the chat.
- A built-in world-time tool answers time questions for cities and time zones, and Nova knows today's date.

### 🎙️ Voice Conversations

- Talk to Nova continuously, hear its replies, and interrupt it at any time.
- Voice connects through Compass using your saved Compass API key, so there is no separate voice provider to set up.

### 🔐 You Stay in Control

- Nova asks before taking actions that change things, and you choose whether to allow an action once, for the current task, or always.
- Sensitive actions are protected, and Nova re-checks the screen after you approve an action.
- Your Compass API key is stored in the secure credential storage, and audit logs hide sensitive details.
- Limits on the number of actions and requests per task keep long-running tasks in check.

### 📋 Tool Activity

- Each tool Nova uses appears under the message that triggered it, with its current status.
- Status messages show what Nova is doing while it starts up and while it works on your computer.

### 🔄 Secure In-App Updates

- Check for, download, and install signed updates from **Settings**, with release notes and download progress.
- Updates wait until Nova is not busy, and your conversation is restored after the update. Screenshots and pending actions are not kept.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Bundled computer-control files are now packaged byte-for-byte, so their integrity checks pass.
- Release packaging was aligned with the Nova Echo name, and release tests run one at a time to avoid startup conflicts.

## ⚙️ Under the Hood

- Built with Tauri 2, Rust, React, and TypeScript.
- The computer-control component ships with a pinned Node runtime, integrity checks, provenance records, and a dependency inventory.
- A development-only switch lets debug builds use a local backend. It is ignored in release builds and keeps separate credentials.
- Automated Rust and Node tests cover commands, permissions, voice, updates, and release packaging.

🛸 Co-authored with [Nova](https://www.compassap.ai/nova)
